m: Oven to 160°C. Season the shanks and brown all over in a heavy ovenproof pot. Set aside.
Soften the onion and carrot 8 minutes, add the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes, rosemary and stock powder with 1 cup water per 2 shanks. Nestle the shanks in.
Lid on and braise 3 hours, turning once, until the meat is falling off the bone.
Mash: boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with butter, warm milk and salt until smooth.
Lift out the shanks, thicken the sauce with cornflour mixed into a little cold water. Serve over mash with the beans and plenty of sauce.
l: Pull the meat off the bone and pack over the mash with the sauce. Reheats beautifully.
g: Check the stock powder and use 100% maize cornflour. Naturally GF otherwise.
